verdict.rationale: Greptile documents dashboard-level settings that serve as defaults, and admin settings at the org level (Settings → Code Review), so an org-wide baseline is implied. Per-repo exceptions come from a `greptile.json` in each repository that overrides the dashboard, and settings can be scoped to the directories each team owns. That makes exception handling decentralized, in each repo's files, rather than managed from one central place. Missing for 10: explicit docs that the dashboard sets org-wide review defaults inherited by all repos, a central view or tool for managing per-repo exceptions, evidence of bulk rollout across hundreds of repos, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
